results.title: Harnessing the power of synthetic data in healthcare: innovation, application, and privacy | npj Digital Medicine
results.content: # Harnessing the power of synthetic data in healthcare: innovation, application, and privacy. We begin with real-world healthcare applications of synthetic data that informs government policy, enhance data privacy, and augment datasets for predictive analytics. We explore the issues of data quality and data bias in synthetic data, which can limit applicability across different applications in the clinical context, and privacy concerns stemming from data misuse and risk of re-identification. Finally, we evaluate the role of regulatory agencies in promoting transparency and accountability and propose strategies for risk mitigation such as Differential Privacy (DP) and a dataset chain of custody to maintain data integrity, traceability, and accountability. ### A scoping review of privacy and utility metrics in medical synthetic data. In this article we review the generation techniques, applications, and definitions of synthetic data in the context of healthcare and explore associated privacy issues.
